scenes.narration: Welcome to the My Church Resource App, your central hub for team schedules, resources and community.
Three things stay on the bottom of the app: Chat, the Feed, and Calendar. Everything else starts with your initials in the top right.
Tap your initials. My Schedule is the full list of dates you are serving. Swaps is where you answer trade requests. Dashboard is where you ask for a break.
The bell next to your initials is for alerts inside the app. Phone push notifications are separate, and we turn those on next.
